description.value:
Spellbinder · уровень 6

You may cast Magic Circle as a Ritual once per day.
Your influence over your Vassals deepens. You can summon your Vassal into a Magic Circle you have cast and when you do so, it gains the ability to cast the corresponding spells as shown on the Spellbinding table without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. When it does so, the Vassal reduces its maximum Hit Points by 5 plus 5 times the level of the spell.
The Vassal cannot cast a spell that is of a higher level than your highest level spell slot.

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Выдача заклинаний вассалу и снижение его максимума HP — вручную. 1/day интерпретировано как Long Rest; можно изменить в счётчике.

source.custom: Legends of the Round Table: Chivalric Handbook
